text: Done, from the Mason Park brand guide in the shared drive (Nikole Culo Designs, Nov 2021). Colors are now the guide's exact palette: slate #545F62, sage #A0B4AA, light grey #EAE9E6, copper #B78668, sand #CCBCA6 and beige #E2D5C5. The copper replaces the yellow and the sky blue we had added. Where copper sits behind text (buttons, badges) it is a deeper shade of the same copper so it stays readable (ADA contrast). Fonts: the guide's Collier, FreightNeo Pro and Avenir Next are Adobe-licensed fonts we have no web licence for, so the site uses the closest open fonts: Marcellus for Collier (it matches the logo lettering) and Figtree for Avenir Next. If the practice has an Adobe Fonts web project, send the kit ID and we will switch to the exact fonts. Applied on every page of staging.

Done everywhere, not just on this card. "In a hospital setting" and "at HCA West Houston" are removed from all 9 pages that said it (Sedation Dentistry, Our Services, About, Our Doctors, Refer a Patient, Comprehensive Pediatric Dentistry, Crowns, Extractions, Restorative), and from the Sedation page's search description. General anesthesia is still listed, with no location. Let us know if you want a line on where it is done.
